main_comparator.authors: Yann Barbotin, Ali Hormati, Sundeep Rangan, Martin Vetterli
main_comparator.title: Estimation of Sparse MIMO Channels with Common Support
locators: Section VII, complexity and model-order discussion
main_comparator.summary: The noiseless complex common-node model admits a common annihilating recurrence. Its numerical recovery procedures use a supplied model-order estimate, matrix decompositions, root extraction, and channel amplitude solves. It does not give ALG-007's complete raw-input finite-field verification, cap-rejection, or all-output Green-transform cost contract.

secondary_context.authors: Joris van der Hoeven and Gregoire Lecerf
secondary_context.title: Sparse polynomial interpolation: Faster strategies over finite fields
secondary_context.summary: The vector-polynomial remark connects shared support with vector coefficients. Algorithm 4 specifies a polynomial evaluation interface, known degree and term bounds, an element of order at least max(D,2T), Pade reconstruction, root recovery, discrete logarithms, and coefficient recovery. Its field and bit costs cannot be silently used as the full ALG-007 cost.

reviewer_derivation_boundary: The forward annihilator and joint-minimality argument in the audit are independently derived from the exact ALG-007 block transform. They are not assertions that either external publication proves the complete ALG-007 algorithm.
